description: This file defines a static class 'ConfigureCoreServices' with an extension method 'AddCoreServices' for configuring dependency injection services in an ASP.NET Core application. It registers various application services, repositories, and logging components related to the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: ConfigureCoreServices
classes.description: A static class providing extension method to add core application services to the dependency injection container.

methods.name: AddCoreServices
methods.description: Extension method that registers core application services, repositories, logging, and configuration dependencies into the IServiceCollection for dependency injection.
